C2. Criterion 6(г) now reads: if there is no end of answer (interruption, API error), the row is closed as «окончание не записано» at the next request of the same session or at a session-end event after its start, and if neither happened, at a server start after its start (as for tasks in (в)); a row closed only by a server start stays open for an end of answer: one that comes later closes it as «завершена»; an end-of-answer event without an open row changes nothing. The rest of (г) is as before.
This is the design’s rule exactly:
- §4.2: the first of Stop, next request and session end decides, and only if none exists does a server start with journal_lines > the row’s index close it (closed_by server_start in §3.5);
- D9 option 2 and README limitation 7 («следующим запросом, концом сессии или запуском сервера»);
- the late Stop gives «завершена» (the self-correction noted in §4.2).
The «Проверка:» line of criterion 6 now names PG-12d6’s scenario: request, then server start gives «окончание не записано», then end of answer gives «завершена». I added no scenario the design has no test for (for example a server start before the request); the generic «отдельный сценарий на каждое правило» covers the boundary.
The «Сбои» paragraph got one sentence: a main-session row without an end of answer stays «обрабатывает запрос» until the next request, a session end or a server start.
Dry run of the amended rule (scratchpad/mainrow-sim.mjs). The design’s first-event rule was compared with an independent event-driven reading of the new wording, at every prefix of 4,000 random journals (two sessions, resumes, 0-3 server starts; 38,734 comparisons): 0 differences. A reading in which a server start closes the row for good differs in 1,476 cases, which is why the late-Stop sentence is in the text. Scenarios:
- request, then server start: unrecorded; then a Stop: completed;
- server start before the request: in progress;
- server start, then next request, or session end: unrecorded;
- no server start: in progress;
- session end, resume, then a Stop with no row: the row stays unrecorded.
No REQ-007 text change for C2: the design (§4.5) makes the «Основная сессия» character work while a main row is open, and REQ-007’s criteria never say when that character works, so the new closure reaches the office through REQ-001 6(г). Observation, not changed: REQ-007 leaves that state to the design.

C3. tools/test/pixel-office-helpers.js is in the write-set lists of both requirements, as one new file shared by REQ-001 and REQ-007 tests, with the reason it is not *.test.js. «Прежние тесты не меняются» and «только новые файлы» are kept, and tools/test/helpers.js is named as unchanged, since the two names are close. - `npm test` is `node --test "test/**/*.test.js"`. With a helper whose top level calls a throwing test, npm test ran 1 test with 0 failures, so the helper is not run.

- The Q6 directive grep over tools/test catches an inline `/* eslint no-undef: 0 */` inside it.

C1: no requirement edit. Criterion 7 can be read to demand the outcome of all three parts, so it is a design fix.
- (a) Timeout. «если сервер недоступен — пишет «Нет связи с сервером Pixel Office»» is not met by a page that waits for ever on a server that accepted the connection and never answers, and the bound «показывает новое событие не позже чем через 5 секунд» is broken while the poll hangs. The same requirement already lists «сервер завис (принял соединение и не отвечает)» as a failure case for the hook (criterion 10).
- (c) from equal to entries.length is the means to «после восстановления догружает пропущенные события» without duplicates or shifted indices: criterion 5 requires one array, and criterion 4’s rules are index-based.
- (b) One request in flight is a means to (c), not a demand of the letter.
The «Проверка:» line of criterion 7 names only «обрыв и восстановление», so the design must add the tests the validator proposed: hung server, a response with the wrong from, visibility. If ORCH wants the hung-server case spelled out in the requirement, one phrase in that «Проверка:» line would do; I did not apply it, since the ruling was a design fix.

Not applied: the design findings C4-C10 and the validator’s hardening proposals (for example the `/* global x */` pattern for the AC14 directive grep) are not requirement edits under the ruling «No other criterion changes». The hardening proposals are for ORCH to record as decisions (quality-bar §4). Open: nothing new.
